name: council-of-rivals
description: Adversarial multi-persona collision arena and Double-Crux extractor across any non-coding or coding domain—strategy, career/life choices, investments, policy, creative work, science, and architecture. Casts 3–5 conflicting minds with incompatible incentives to cross-examine your idea and each other in any user-set tone, isolating the exact Crux Map and decisive test.
suggestedPrompts: Convene a Council of Rivals (3 conflicting minds with incompatible incentives) to tear apart this plan and extract the Crux Map
Run an adversarial tribunal on my career decision: cast a Risk-Averse Realist, an Asymmetric-Upside Founder, and Future-Me at Age 60
Pit a Short-Seller, a Power-User Customer, and a First-Principles Engineer against each other on this product strategy
